name: Discord ChatOps
description: Slash commands in your Discord server for the panel: /status, /logs, /start, /stop, /restart and /deploy. Each person acts with their own panel permissions after linking Discord and allowing ChatOps; changes need a confirmation button.

capabilities.name: identity.discord
capabilities.reason: Find the panel account that linked the Discord user who ran a command, and check that they allowed ChatOps.

capabilities.name: bots.read
capabilities.reason: List and show the bots that person can see.

capabilities.name: bot.power
capabilities.reason: Start, stop and restart bots for /start, /stop and /restart, after a confirmation.

capabilities.name: bot.deploy
capabilities.reason: Redeploy a bot from its linked repository for /deploy, after a confirmation.

capabilities.name: kv
capabilities.reason: Remember pending confirmations for one minute and recently handled interactions.

capabilities.name: settings
capabilities.reason: Read the application id and guild.

capabilities.name: http.fetch
capabilities.reason: Register the slash commands with Discord.

settings.label: Application ID
settings.description: From the Discord Developer Portal, General Information.

settings.label: Public key
settings.description: From the Developer Portal, General Information. Every request from Discord is checked against it.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.description: From the Developer Portal, OAuth2. Used only to register the slash commands; it is never readable by the extension.

settings.label: Server ID (optional)
settings.description: Register the commands in one server, where they appear at once. Empty registers them everywhere the app is installed (can take up to an hour).

user_consent.explanation: Discord ChatOps runs slash commands in Discord as you, with your panel permissions, once your Discord account is linked under Settings → Connected accounts. Choose what it may do for you.

scopes.label: See bots
scopes.description: /status lists the bots you can see and their state.

scopes.label: Read output
scopes.description: /logs shows a bot's recent console output (only to you).

scopes.label: Start, stop, restart
scopes.description: /start, /stop and /restart, each after a confirmation button.

scopes.label: Deploy
scopes.description: /deploy redeploys a bot from its linked repository, after a confirmation button.
